_comment: For editors only. `ty` is the type checker CI runs (see [tool.ty] in
pyproject.toml); this file exists because Pylance and Pyright resolve
imports from the workspace folder rather than from the installed
environment, and `digitex` is a PEP 420 namespace contributed to by three
workspace members. Without the roots listed here every `import
digitex.domain.entities` in the editor reads as unresolved, while `ty`,
pytest and the running bot all resolve it fine.
Add a member here when you add one to [tool.uv.workspace].
Only the paths are set. `typeCheckingMode` is deliberately left alone so
the editor keeps whatever the developer chose — this file fixes resolution,
it does not appoint a second type checker with opinions of its own.
